title: Net force first
target: Combine forces before using mass to predict acceleration.
criteria: Find net force before dividing by mass.
State acceleration with units and direction.
Separate acceleration direction from motion direction.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A 5 kg cart experiences 32 N right and 12 N left. What is net force?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A student uses only a 24 N pull to calculate acceleration, ignoring 9 N friction. What is the first correction?
options: Add both magnitudes to get 33 N.
cpa.guide: Acceleration responds to the vector sum of forces.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: A 5 kg cart has net force 20 N left. What is acceleration?
cpa.guide: a = F_net/m = 20/5 = 4 m/s² in the force direction.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A 6 kg object has 10 N right and 28 N left. What is acceleration?
cpa.guide: Net force is 18 N left; a = 18/6 = 3 m/s² left.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A cart moves right while its net force points left. What happens initially?
options: It instantly moves left regardless of initial speed.
cpa.guide: Force sets acceleration; opposite velocity and acceleration initially slow the cart.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: An object moves left with zero net force. Which prediction follows?
options: It accelerates right to cancel the leftward velocity.
Its velocity stays constant unless a net force later acts.
cpa.guide: Zero net force gives zero acceleration, not zero velocity.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.
